changes.comment: Add quantity formatting for FieldRun values in text annotations via `ElementDrivesTextAnnotation.evaluateFieldsAsync`. Format is resolved in priority order: inline `FormatProps` override, KoQ name looked up via the active `FormatsProvider`, the ECProperty's own `KindOfQuantity`, then a meters fallback for `"coordinate"`. The synchronous `evaluateFields` and txn field-update callbacks continue to use `value.toString()` for back-compat.
